propose.normative_voice: A Compiler Capability Description shall state the supported families of domain declarations, expected compilation outcomes, rejection conditions and limits, without standing in for a concrete domain declaration.
propose.formal_voice: Capability = (supported_contracts, input_requirements, promised_outputs, rejection_rules, limits); describes(Capability, Contract) does not imply instance_of(Capability, Contract).
propose.plain_language_voice: It says what the compiler can do for many domains.
propose.domain_context_voice: AlchLang supports explicit mappings and policies; that statement is not itself an Order-to-Message mapping or a strategy-selection policy.
propose.boundary: A capability promise does not prove implementation coverage, approval or conformance, and is not an executable Mapping or Policy node.
propose.drift_route: Return to the same scoped Definition Pack; preserve existing canonical and candidate antecedents.

propose.normative_voice: A Language Construct Contract shall define a kind of declaration through its required information, type/reference rules, semantics, failure behavior and authority limits, independently of any one domain instance.
propose.formal_voice: K = (kind, required_fields, well_formedness, meaning, failures, limits); conforms(d,K) checks an individual declaration against that contract.
propose.plain_language_voice: It is the rulebook for writing one kind of domain instruction.
propose.domain_context_voice: The Mapping contract requires explicit field clauses and missing-value behavior; the AlchLang Policy contract requires ordered cases and a declared default.
propose.boundary: A contract is not an individual declaration, a provider binding or evidence that every compiler version supports it.
propose.drift_route: Return to the same scoped Definition Pack; preserve existing canonical and candidate antecedents.

propose.normative_voice: A Domain Construct Declaration shall bind one language construct contract to an explicit bounded domain, identity, owner, operands and references. Missing required semantics shall remain unresolved and prevent successful lowering.
propose.formal_voice: d = (id, domain, owner, contract_ref, operands, references); lower(d,B) is eligible only when required meaning and references are closed and B supports the selected contract.
propose.plain_language_voice: It is one actual instruction written for a particular domain.
propose.domain_context_voice: OrderToMessage and ChooseDeliveryStrategy would be two different declarations, each with its own inputs and rules. They are illustrative examples, not existing approved artifacts.
propose.boundary: A declaration describes behavior; it is not a runtime invocation, owner approval or authorization to act.
propose.drift_route: Return to the same scoped Definition Pack; preserve existing canonical and candidate antecedents.

propose.normative_voice: A Concrete Mapping Declaration shall bind source and target shapes to explicit, uniquely named target-field clauses and total/partial missing-value behavior. It shall construct only declared output values from supplied input and typed defaults.
propose.formal_voice: M = (S,T,clauses,totality); evaluate_M(x) -> Result<declared fields of T,MappingError>. Use each declared source value when present, otherwise its declared typed default; unresolved total output rejects, while partial output may omit the field.
propose.plain_language_voice: It specifies exactly how to build a new value from another value.
propose.domain_context_voice: Illustration: Order.orderId -> OrderMessage.orderId; Order.total -> OrderMessage.amount; typed default GBP -> OrderMessage.currency. These clauses are authored examples, not inferred domain requirements.
propose.boundary: No implicit copy-through, persistence or transport. Value semantics do not establish that a particular untyped DomainSpec representation accepts a Value Object endpoint; the selected typed profile must be checked separately.
propose.drift_route: Return to the same scoped Definition Pack; preserve existing canonical and candidate antecedents.

propose.normative_voice: A Concrete Policy Declaration in the AlchLang typed-policy profile shall bind declared inputs to a nonempty ordered case list and an explicit default, returning one declared strategy selector without executing it.
propose.formal_voice: P = (inputs,[(p1,t1),...,(pn,tn)],td); evaluate_P(x)=t_i for the least i with p_i(x)=true, otherwise td. Invalid inputs or predicates reject.
propose.plain_language_voice: It chooses a named strategy using an explicit order and fallback.
propose.domain_context_voice: Illustration: if an order is urgent select ExpressDelivery; otherwise select StandardDelivery. Both are declared example targets, and selection alone performs no delivery.
propose.boundary: First-match behavior is scoped to this AlchLang profile, not all policies. A compiler representation with different overlap semantics must not silently replace it; selection grants no execution authority.
propose.drift_route: Return to the same scoped Definition Pack; preserve existing canonical and candidate antecedents.

propose.normative_voice: A DomainSpec Compiler Binding shall identify the selected compiler package/version, public interface, supported source contract/profile and evidence scope. It shall keep package version, source-schema version and AlchLang version distinct.
propose.formal_voice: B=(package,version,public_interface,source_contract,profile,evidence_scope); selected package=@domainspec-v2/cli and version=1.0.0. Successful use requires a matching built API and a compatible authored project.
propose.plain_language_voice: It says exactly which compiler processes the model and which inputs it understands.
propose.domain_context_voice: The existing bridge selects @domainspec-v2/cli@1.0.0; domainspec.project/v1 and carrier-v2 are separate format versions. General .alch-to-DomainSpec lowering remains unimplemented.
propose.boundary: A version match is not whole-package provenance, complete language compatibility, semantic acceptance, a ConstructionBinding or runtime authorization.
propose.drift_route: Return to the same scoped Definition Pack; preserve existing canonical and candidate antecedents.
